profile.name: Sabit Shaikholla
profile.headline: From telecom systems
profile.lede: AI/LLM and Forward Deployed Engineer at Netcracker, and solution architect for digital channels. I build RAG and agent systems over internal company data and run LLMs on our own hardware. Before that: telecom platforms used by millions, and research on how industry adopts new technology.

roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
roles.summary: Building and running on-premise LLM infrastructure for internal engineering platforms.
wins: Reached 100+ tokens/s and cut time-to-first-token by 52% against baseline by deploying Kimi-K2.6 (MoE) on SGLang and GPT-OSS 120B on vLLM, on-premise; self-hosted models from embeddings up to 1T parameters.
Cut hallucination rate by 73% and improved internal search relevance by 65% with enterprise RAG over 100+ code repositories, 1,000+ Confluence pages and 5,000+ documents.
Held 0.89 faithfulness, 0.92 answer relevance, 0.86 context precision and 0.84 context recall on a 15K-query benchmark with an automated RAGAS evaluation loop on every pipeline change.
Recovered answers that nearest-neighbour search missed in mixed-format documents, using agents that decide what to read themselves: scan, deep dive, backtrack.
Replaced hand-copying of agent skills between projects with a marketplace on APM (Agent Package Manager): skills as installable packages with versioning and dependency resolution.

roles.title: Solution Architect, Digital Channels
roles.summary: du digital transformation programme. Own the mobile and web applications end to end, from requirements elicitation through production release and monitoring, plus the solution architecture behind them.
wins: Cut time-to-market from 8 weeks to 4 by merging solution delivery for mobile, web and self-care into a single intake, design path and release train.
Raised throughput at the design and solutioning stage by 40% by owning the cross-stream work that used to fall between teams: requirements sign-off, interface contracts and dependency resolution.

Aligned 5 delivery streams on one architecture baseline by owning the target solution architecture for digital channels: BSS/OSS integration design (Order Management, Product Catalog, Billing, CRM), API contracts and non-functional requirements.
Halved the build effort for every new customer journey, one build instead of two, by consolidating mobile and web onto a shared API layer.
Cut clarification loops between business and delivery by 50% by turning business requirements into specifications engineering can build without a second pass.
Caught 90% of digital-channel defects before production and cut MTTR by 60% by carrying every release through to production and owning post-release monitoring.

roles.title: E2E Delivery Owner, Mobile & Web
roles.summary: Nuuday digital transformation programme. Owned the mobile and web applications end to end, from requirements elicitation through production release, monitoring and test.
wins: Ran the full delivery cycle for customer-facing mobile and web: requirements with business stakeholders → technical specifications → build coordination → E2E test → production release → post-release monitoring.
Architected an event-driven integration layer connecting BSS/OSS modules (Order Management, Provisioning, Billing, CRM) to the new self-service portal; order-to-activation 70% faster.
Designed and delivered a cloud-native feature-flag framework (Kafka + Redis Streams) for a 2M+ DAU web app: 15+ concurrent features, release cycle from 6 weeks to 4 days, rollback incidents down 80%.
Established the E2E testing framework across 30+ microservices handling billing, ordering and customer data: 95% test automation coverage, production defects down 75%.

entries.about: Leading mobile telecom provider in Kazakhstan, building a SuperApp ecosystem across payments, e-commerce and telecom services ($1.32B+ market capitalization).

roles.title: Lead Systems Engineer
wins: Led the architectural redesign of the SuperApp ecosystem for 3M+ monthly active users: 99.99% uptime, latency down 60%.
Raised team productivity by 15% leading 10 engineers running the Activ and Kcell SuperApp mobile and web platforms.
Led the migration of the legacy monolithic billing system to microservices, cutting operating costs by $300K a year and improving response time by 65%.
Cut user complaints by 85% and raised NPS from 2.5 to 4.1 (out of 5.0) within 3 months with NLP and data analytics systems.
Built health monitoring for a distributed stack of 20+ components, catching issues early and cutting outages by 70%.
Coordinated design and development with infrastructure systems (BSS/OSS, Enterprise Service Bus, asynchronous product ordering, high-performance application server, CVM) to improve interoperability.

roles.title: Senior Systems Engineer
wins: Built an API gateway integrating 20+ internal and external services; integration incidents down 40%.
Established DevOps practices across 6 teams: deployments from bi-weekly to daily, MTTR down 60%.
Automated testing with Postman across 15 microservices and 100+ APIs, cutting QA cycle time by 70% and catching 95% of bugs before deployment.

roles.title: Systems Engineer
wins: Led the end-to-end redesign of the customer self-service portal for 6M+ users: satisfaction score from 6.7 to 8.3, support tickets down 45%.
Streamlined the release pipeline for the iOS, Android and web SuperApp across 6 teams and 30+ features: time-to-market from 3 months to 3 weeks at a 99.9% crash-free rate.
Built an automated UAT framework for the self-service portal covering 70+ critical scenarios: testing cycles from 2 weeks to 3 days, defect detection up 85%.
Implemented feature flags for a progressive web app serving 2M+ daily users: 15+ features developed in parallel, release cycle from 6 weeks to 1 week.
Sped up project timelines by 15% by helping plan, design and build new applications and enhancements to existing ones.
